items.caption: A received small-seal form of 是, traditionally analyzed as 日 above 正. This analysis describes the seal form and does not establish the bronze graph’s original components.
items.alt: Black seal-script form of 是, with a rounded upper enclosure crossed by a horizontal stroke above a taller lower structure.
items.selection_reason: This form illustrates the received Shuowen analysis, which the dictionary distinguishes from the earlier bronze graph’s unresolved structure.

limitations.text: The image is a modern redraw in seal-script style, not an ancient artifact photograph. The indexed bronze form 集成02724 has no component explanation in the accessible account, so its original graphic formation remains uncertain.
